youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Picking Up Takeout
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用取外帶情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從手機點餐、到店取餐、處理漏餐錯餐，到回家開吃與退款回饋，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Picking Up Takeout phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering app ordering, counter pickup, fixing missing items, and enjoying dinner at home. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們該打開哪個點餐軟體？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我看到他們的麵食菜單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want rice or noodles?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add one box to the cart.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the large size?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can they make it less spicy?
dialogue.zh: 可以請他們做得不那麼辣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I wrote it in notes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is a short drive over.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pay by card in the app.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I will use your card.
dialogue.zh: 好，那我就用你的卡付錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I asked for ice on the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æskt fər aɪs ɑn ðə saɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will eat them right away.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Remove one, it is too much.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The receipt is in the app.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type it in the notes box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write cut the chicken in half.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will arrive right on time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need the car keys?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The store is on Main Street.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have the cups too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait at the store, not home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have both, let us go.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I am here for pickup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lee is the name I used.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it, Lee, here you go.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see a bag with Lee.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a fresh cup?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 可以給我兩包烤肉醬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The spoons are on the left.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are in a round container.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they are by the register.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, we are in a rush.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush, we are almost done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, let me count them first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I split them in two?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to do anything else?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu du ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We try to keep it hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我現在可以先開一杯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am back with the bags.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 東西都在架子上備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then do not touch my phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need plates at home?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let us set the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spoons and napkins too, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put the bags in the back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you ask for the chopsticks?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two packs are in here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the chicken box is gone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look in the bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are right, where is it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need to call the store.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the number is in the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə ˈnʌmbər ɪz ɪn ði æp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你好，這是四十二號訂單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the counter now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the box is still here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can pick it up today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are close, we will return.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You paid for the large one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，能跟我們換一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One minute, the tea is wrong.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們點的是兩杯檸檬茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swap the sweet one for lemon.
dialogue.zh: 把甜的那杯換成檸檬茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, I will fix it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get an extra bag?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, here is a bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you fix the tea too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that cup is lemon now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the label says no sugar.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feel the box, it is hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 炸雞、薯條、麵，還有兩杯茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is everything on the receipt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The receipt is in my pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 店員每個盒子都檢查了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 兩杯茶的蓋子都蓋緊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, no spills in the car.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shoes off, bags on the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The noodles go in a bowl.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Salt is in the little pack.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Told you this place is good.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, the stack is right there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you like the lemon taste?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The large size is the best.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One fry fell on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart choice, take a new one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有，兩包烤肉醬、一包番茄醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 把最後一包辣醬用掉吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we need a bigger box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bill says twice for tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 您好，我打電話來問四十二號訂單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的收據顯示扣了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You paid twice, I see it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the refund is on its way.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə ˈrifʌnd ɪz ɑn ɪts weɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will share that with the team.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ʃɛr ðæt wɪð ðə tim./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 麻煩了，他們真的很親切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you at your next order.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the app says refund sent.
dialogue.zh: 你看，軟體顯示退款已送出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My iced tea is half gone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should check the bill first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們把一整疊都用完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 餐點更新鮮，還不用等外送員。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 留到星期五再用軟體點餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One fry waits for the cat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有外帶、有聊天，還不用洗碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep well, my belly is full.
